chunk-001:c003.proposition: Questions of human value have discoverable right and wrong answers independent of what perpetrators happen to want.

orphanFallback.rationale: The claim independently establishes moral realism by treating better answers about human value as objects of discovery rather than products of individual desire.

chunk-001:c005.proposition: Religion warrants special scrutiny because it treats dogma and belief without compelling evidence as virtues rather than epistemic defects.

orphanFallback.rationale: The move independently identifies faith without compelling evidence as a distinctive religious obstacle to evidence-sensitive correction.

chunk-001:c010.proposition: Many scriptural commands are unambiguous, ethically inferior, and resistant to revision, keeping modern societies tied to Iron Age morality.

orphanFallback.rationale: The cited commands concerning punishment and slavery independently support the claim that scriptural authority can obstruct modern moral correction.

chunk-002:chunk-002-candidate-05.proposition: As theology becomes less literal, it becomes less constrained by scripture and permits modern insights to be projected onto texts whose literal meanings are barbaric or false.

orphanFallback.rationale: The contrast between dangerous literal meanings and unconstrained metaphorical readings independently states the secular reinterpretation dilemma.

chunk-002:chunk-002-candidate-10.proposition: The worst possible misery for every conscious being is intrinsically bad, providing a nonreligious foundation for intelligible judgments about better and worse states.

orphanFallback.rationale: Universal misery supplies a self-contained normative starting point grounded in conscious experience without reliance on God or religious doctrine.

chunk-003:chunk-003-candidate-06.proposition: An abstract definition of God omits the personal supernatural agent ordinarily meant by believers and changes the traditional noun rather than defending it.

orphanFallback.rationale: The discrepancy between an abstract moral construct and the commonly professed prayer-answering deity independently challenges the adequacy of pragmatic God-language.

chunk-003:chunk-003-candidate-08.proposition: The experience described as answered prayer is familiar human psychology and requires neither supernatural causation nor divine authorship of scripture.

orphanFallback.rationale: Recognizing introspective self-correction as an ordinary psychological process independently supplies a naturalized explanation of the reported spiritual experience.

chunk-003:chunk-003-candidate-09.proposition: Incompatible religious traditions assign conflicting meanings to good and evil, so their usefulness points toward a deeper common reality rather than the truth of any one tradition.

orphanFallback.rationale: The coexistence of useful but doctrinally irreconcilable traditions independently weakens claims that any single religious tradition has distinctive authority.

chunk-004:c004-01.proposition: Religious and cultural variation undermines the claim that supposedly universal moral patterns recur consistently across traditions.

orphanFallback.rationale: The possibility that cultures invert allegedly shared moral concepts independently challenges religious narratives as reliable evidence of universal structure.

chunk-004:c004-06.proposition: Religious heuristics are unreliable because they can produce adaptive behavior for mistaken reasons and cannot adjust reliably when circumstances change.

orphanFallback.rationale: The distinction between useful fictions and reality-based explanations independently shows why inherited rules can become obsolete as conditions change.

chunk-004:c004-08.proposition: Causal understanding improves practical guidance by identifying the variables that matter and replacing inherited taboos that track outcomes blindly.

orphanFallback.rationale: The comparison with pre-scientific hygiene and dietary taboos independently shows how discovering causal mechanisms permits arbitrary rules to be revised.

chunk-004:c004-09.proposition: A worldview continuously corrected through honest engagement with reality is preferable to one anchored in unchanging ideas formed without modern investigative tools.

orphanFallback.rationale: The proposition independently states the epistemic advantage of revisable, evidence-sensitive inquiry over doctrines fixed under ancient informational limitations.
